leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the animation-fill-mode property to control element states before and after animation execution
Configure animation-direction values to manipulate playback sequences (normal, reverse, alternate, alternate-reverse)
Construct CSS animations that maintain final frame states using fill-mode settings
Integrate fill-mode and direction properties to create complex animation behaviors
Manipulate animation timing by combining direction with iteration counts
Update existing animations to use appropriate fill-mode values for different UI scenarios
Implement directional animation patterns that respond to user interactions
